reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 expressly records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment and preserves Customer's freedom to hire anyone responding to general recruitment, matching the preferred position of no non-solicit binding Customer.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the paragraph is returned unchanged.
The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit covenant to measure, not evidence of a defect.

Correctly declines to flag the § 12.4 non-compete here, avoiding double-flagging the same commercial term under a separate restrictive-covenant rule, and correctly refrains from flagging language that benefits our party.
